change_plan.scope: Private performance experiment only; production branch remains 5c675076.
change_plan.hypothesis: Grouping each packed scale table and the word-wise input shift under one common-path check reduces repeated branch/mask overhead. Scalar shift arithmetic, scale selection, rounding and consumer float modes are unchanged.
change_plan.required: Build all shader variants, pass packed/consumer native checks and ordinary output identity, then monitored matched performance. No promotion on a compile or timing result alone.
change_plan.status: prepared; no compilation or execution while cost-isolation benchmark runs
